actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The corrected left stage shows a helmeted actor actively riding a complete bicycle under Nutzen, resolving the manufacturing/use confusion. The right stage is now labelled Recycling and visibly sorts recovered materials/parts with recycling marks and a separate residual waste branch, resolving the earlier reuse/recycling ambiguity. Correctly directed large arrows connect use, repair and recycling; no perfect lossless recycling claim is made.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px actual cycling, repair work, material sorting, all three headings and the circular arrows are recognizable. The residual waste icon remains separate.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the complete used bicycle and the recycling sorting bins are clear; the changed labels correspond to the actual scenes.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The rider looks along their direction of travel and holds the bicycle handlebars normally. Repair and material work face the actors correctly; no legible reversed instrument or notebook appears.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: This simplified cycle shows selected circular-economy stages; it is not an exhaustive manufacturing lifecycle or a claim that every material is infinitely recyclable.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
